<a id="cafe-thirteen-camera-angles"></a>

## One Cafe Take Re-Shot From Thirteen Camera Angles

[![Seedance 2.5 comparison of an original cafe take and a re-shot camera angle](<https://pbs.twimg.com/amplify_video_thumb/2102364937355923456/img/6Zj_tkPWGn0K1EFh.jpg>)](<https://x.com/Scenario_gg/status/2102365054389899695>)

A video-to-video workflow preserves one cafe performance while re-photographing it from thirteen timed camera positions.

**Model:** Seedance 2.5

### Video-to-video prompt · `en`

```text
ONE FINISHED TAKE, RE-PHOTOGRAPHED

@video1 is one finished take: a single locked-off wide, 19.53 s, with its original audio, a young man at an outdoor cafe table talking to one camera. Do not restage, re-perform, re-time or reinterpret it. Re-photograph the identical event from thirteen new camera positions, as if thirteen extra cameras had been rolling around him in the same moment. Every output frame shows the same body at the same instant of @video1 at the same speed. Output runs the full 19.53 s. Keep the audio of @video1 unchanged and in sync.

DO NOT CHANGE
Performance, body, hands and what they hold, head angle, eyeline, lip movement, blink timing, movement speed, action start and end times, lighting, exposure, white balance, colour grade, wardrobe, props, set. The only variable is camera position and lens.

SPEECH WINDOWS (measured from the audio of @video1)
SPEAKING: 0.00-1.65, 2.05-4.80, 5.95-6.90, 9.65-11.75, 12.20-12.85, 13.35-13.80, 16.70-16.90, 17.60-18.90.
SILENT, mouth closed and still or chewing: 1.65-2.05, 4.80-5.95, 6.90-9.65 (drinking), 11.75-12.20, 12.85-13.35, 13.80-16.70 (chewing), 16.90-17.60, 18.90-19.55.
Whenever his mouth is visible in a SPEAKING window it moves in lip-sync with the audio of @video1. He talks while looking down: from 2.05 to 4.80 his head is down at the laptop and he is speaking. Head down is not silent. Never add speech to a silent window, never mute a speaking one.

EYELINE RULE
He performed to ONE camera, the A-camera: the original locked-off wide, directly in front of him at seated eye level. His eyeline stays on that spot in every shot, apart from the glances down at keyboard, mug and pastry already in @video1. He never looks for or turns toward a new camera. From above he reads cap and brow; from the sides, three-quarter or profile; from behind, the back of his head. Single exception: the on-axis shot at 00:01-00:02 sits where the A-camera was, so there alone he looks into the lens.

TEMPO RULE
Real time, 1:1 with @video1. No speed ramps, added slow motion, freeze frames or time remaps. Exactly one slowed passage exists, already baked into the source: the pastry at the top of its arc, 12.5-13.55. Reproduce it at the speed it already has, no slower, no longer.

TOSS TIMING
The pastry leaves his fingers at 12.43 and is caught at 13.60: airborne about one second only. Do not stretch, loop or hang the flight. Before 12.43 and after 13.60 it is in his hand.

EMPTY SKY
On every low or upward-tilting shot the sky is plain pale overcast and empty. No skyscrapers, glass towers, solar panels, cranes, birds, aircraft, sun disc, structured clouds, lens flare or signage. Above his head only cream wall, white pillars and flat pale sky.

CAMERA PLAN

[00:00-00:01] High-angle MCU from above and to his right, about 40 degrees down, chest up, slow push-in, 35mm feel, moderate depth of field, cap brim and open gesturing palms, marble edge in the lower foreground. Speaking, reading three-quarter, not to this lens.

[00:01-00:02] ON THE A-CAMERA AXIS. ECU of his face, dead front, seated eye level, 85mm feel, shallow focus, pillars soft cream behind. The one shot where he looks into the lens. Hands drop below frame onto the keyboard; mouth closes at 1.65.

[00:02-00:05] Macro along the MacBook keyboard to his typing fingers, lens centimetres above the keys, razor-thin focus, keycaps sharp, his face soft far behind, head down. Speaking 2.05-4.80: where his mouth shows in the blur it moves with the audio. Fingers lift at 5.0.

[00:05-00:06] Top-down bird's eye straight down over the table, 24mm feel, deep focus, locked off. Marble disc fills frame: open laptop, white mug, financier, his cap at the bottom edge. Right hand crosses to the mug handle.

[00:06-00:07] Lens resting on the marble at table height, 50mm feel. White mug large and sharp in the left foreground; his hand enters from the right, grips the handle, lifts the mug up out of frame. Torso soft behind. Speaking 5.95-6.90.

[00:07-00:09] First-person POV from his seat, ultra-wide 18mm feel, gentle handheld breathing. The mug rim rises into the bottom of frame and tips toward the lens; laptop screen and marble beyond in deep focus. No face; framing dips to the mug, never up. Silent.

[00:09-00:10] Extreme wide, slow dolly out, 24mm feel, deep focus. He is small at his table mid-terrace: cream wall, pillars, concentric-circle mural, taped boxes behind, slatted bench visible. He sets the mug on the marble 9.4-10.0; speech resumes 9.65.

[00:10-00:12] Low and to his left, lens just above the marble, 50mm feel, shallow focus, table edge and mug soft in the near foreground. Right hand reaches out at 10.5 and lifts the golden financier into sharp focus before his left profile. Talking to the A-camera: full profile here.

[00:12-00:14] Low beside him, 35mm feel, slight Dutch. Opens on the pastry in his fingers; at 12.43 it leaves his hand and the camera tilts UP, following it against plain pale overcast sky and the top of a white pillar through the baked-in slow apex 12.5-13.55, then tilts DOWN for the catch at 13.60 into cupped hands, head tipped back, mouth open, then head coming forward.

[00:14-00:15] Behind him, over his right shoulder, 50mm feel, moderate focus. Back of the black Yankees cap and long dark hair fill frame-left; laptop glow and marble past his shoulder. Head settles level, hands bring the pastry toward his mouth. No face. Silent.

[00:15-00:16] ECU on his mouth and jaw, 100mm macro feel, very shallow focus, soft open-sky light. The financier enters from below, he bites, crumbs, the jaw chews. Chewing, not speaking. Nothing above the nose in frame.

[00:16-00:18] Slow orbit from his left toward front, 35mm feel, moderate focus, mural and pillars parallaxing behind, table crossing the foreground. He chews, speaks 16.70-16.90 and from 17.60, open palms, a small shrug. As the orbit nears front his gaze lands near, not into, this moving lens.

[00:18-00:20] Top-down bird's eye straight down over the table, 24mm feel, deep focus, locked off. Hands come down beside the laptop and settle, cap centred, speech ends 18.90, then still. Hold to 19.53.

SET AND SUBJECT CONTINUITY (identical in every shot)
Young man, long dark hair, black short-sleeve button-up shirt with a small chest logo, black New York Yankees baseball cap, grey trousers. Light wood slatted bench, round white marble table, outdoor cafe terrace. On the table: open dark grey MacBook, white mug with a circular graphic, one small golden financier. Behind him: cream wall, white cylindrical pillars, large black-and-white concentric-circle mural, taped cardboard boxes. Soft overcast open-shade daylight, no hard shadows, constant direction and softness. Warm bright grade: cream walls, golden wood, neutral white marble, warm skin, deep neutral blacks. He is alone; no passers-by, no staff.

No on-screen text, captions, subtitles, watermarks or logos beyond the small chest logo and cap emblem already in @video1.
```

### How to adapt it

Replace @video1 and remeasure every action and speech window. Keep the performance locked while changing only the camera position and lens plan.

## POPBOT Toy-City Mech Boss Battle

[![POPBOT character fighting a giant toy mech in a Seedance 2.5 video](<https://pbs.twimg.com/amplify_video_thumb/2084525436281958400/img/Fu80w4K3KjbIRJUg.jpg>)](<https://x.com/Mayz1169/status/2084530475792753069>)

A 30-second continuous anime-inspired boss fight keeps a locked character design moving across a giant toy mech.

**Model:** Seedance 2.5

### Video prompt · `en`

```text
Toy-world giant boss battle CG, 30 seconds, one continuous unbroken take, seamless continuation from the previous shot. No scene reset, no intro, no establishing shot, no pause, no boss defeat pose. The first frame must continue from the previous ending: POPBOT PRO is already standing on the giant mech titan’s chest armor platform, facing its glowing head at extreme close range above a massive toy city. Camera movement, lighting, character pose, wind, and momentum must continue seamlessly from the previous shot.

Character lock (no changes):
A small agile girl POPBOT PRO with long silver-white hair, loose twin tails, pale blue-grey eyes, pink X bandage on her cheek, focused expression. Blue bunny-ear cap with pink inner ears and goggles, black and hot pink headphones, oversized cobalt blue bomber jacket with bunny patch and X badges, white cropped top, black shorts, white utility belt, mismatched socks, blue-yellow-pink platform sneakers. She carries a huge cobalt blue, yellow and black toy cannon with pink handle and X markings. Color palette locked: hot pink, yellow, cobalt blue, white, black, grey.

Boss lock:
A hundred-meter toy titan mech made of glossy plastic and diecast materials, huge mechanical fists, chunky joints, visible screws and molded seams. Deep grey and matte blue armor, blue helmet with hot pink crest, glowing yellow eye visor, shoulder missile pods, pink-yellow energy lines, glowing chest core.

Environment:
A giant toy city battlefield with colorful building blocks, gift boxes, toy trains, Ferris wheels, carousels, teddy bears, scattered plastic debris. Realistic grey-white skyscrapers in the background, bright blue sky, clouds, colorful confetti floating through the air.

Timeline:

0.0–5.0s | Face-off on the titan
Continue directly from the previous frame. POPBOT stands on the titan’s chest armor, wind blasting through her hair and jacket. She grips her cannon, pulls down her cap, and aims toward the glowing mech head at point-blank range. The titan’s yellow eye visor narrows and intensifies. The mech suddenly raises its head and opens missile pods.

Camera: low-angle push-in from her feet toward her face, shallow depth of field, titan head glowing behind her.

5.0–10.0s | Missile counterattack
The titan launches multiple missiles. POPBOT instantly sprints across the tilted chest armor plates, dodging explosions and mechanical traps. Missiles chase her through the air, smashing toy structures and sending colorful plastic debris everywhere. She jumps between armor gaps while maintaining full speed.

Camera: fast side tracking shot, wide lens, heavy motion blur, explosions crossing the foreground.

10.0–15.0s | Airborne cannon attack
A missile explosion launches her into the air. She spins through the shockwave, stabilizes herself, and fires her giant cannon mid-air. A blue-white energy blast with pink trails destroys the incoming missiles in a chain reaction of colorful explosions above the toy city.

Camera: fast 360-degree orbit around her, toy city rotating below, energetic VFX filling the frame.

15.0–20.0s | Titan arm assault
She lands on the titan’s forearm and immediately charges toward its head. The mech swings its giant fist, but she slides underneath, jumps across moving armor plates, and runs upward along its arm while firing at exposed joints. The titan releases drones and smaller toy machines from hidden panels.

Camera: low perspective following her movement along the massive arm, extreme scale contrast.

20.0–25.0s | Climb to the final strike
POPBOT jumps from the shoulder armor onto the helmet crest. She plants her feet above the glowing eye visor and connects her cannon directly to the mech’s head. The weapon charges with blue, yellow and pink energy. The titan struggles, firing lasers and missiles around her, but she holds position.

Camera: rising crane movement around the titan’s body, revealing the entire toy metropolis battlefield.

25.0–30.0s | Energy blast and continuation
POPBOT fires a massive close-range energy beam into the titan’s head. The helmet cracks, colorful energy bursts through the seams, and the mech begins breaking apart into thousands of flying toy blocks and plastic pieces. She jumps through the falling debris, landing on a giant block while still moving forward.

End frame:
No victory pose, no freeze frame, no explosion ending. The camera follows her momentum into the falling toy debris, cutting during action.

Style:
AAA game boss battle trailer quality, stylized anime-inspired 3D CG, glossy toy materials, Ratchet & Clank + Astro Bot + Hi-Fi Rush feeling. High saturation colors, cinematic lighting, strong rim light, realistic reflections, physical debris simulation, colorful energy effects, constant motion blur, dynamic camera movement, 24fps anamorphic widescreen.

Negative:
Static camera, slow pacing, scene reset, character redesign, hair color change, costume change, weapon change, extra limbs, distorted face, bad hands, subtitles, text, watermark, UI, realistic military weapons, gore, dark desaturated colors, black screen, slow-motion ending.

Audio:
Fast-paced electronic rock with heavy drums, synth brass, toy-box chimes, mechanical servo sounds, missile launches, cannon charging, energy beam impact, plastic destruction sounds. Music keeps building and cuts off mid-action.
```

### How to adapt it

Replace the character sheet, boss design, and toy-city palette together. Preserve the timed escalation, scale contrast, character lock, and continuous forward momentum.

## Teleport-Speed Duel in a Ruined Temple

[![Two stylized fighters facing off in a Seedance 2.5 ruined-temple duel](<https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HS0sRvWaAAA0e4W.jpg>)](<https://x.com/GlitterPixely/status/2102385042529845450>)

Two stylized fighters trade teleport attacks through a 30-second temple battle with locked identities, dialogue, and sound cues.

**Model:** Seedance 2.5

```text
Asset mapping:
@Image 1 defines Character A only: face, sharp amber-brown eyes, thick black eyebrows, freckles, facial scratches, black hair in a messy top knot with long thick braids, torn cream knit crop top with rust-red diamond band, bandage-wrapped left arm, midriff, rust sash. Ignore @Image 1 background, pose, and lighting.
@Image 2 defines Character B only: face, pointed elf ears with hoop, blue-grey eyes, heavy freckles, blush, platinum-blonde hair with two long front braids and red ties, rustic fur-trimmed top, red arm bands, shoulder marks. Ignore @Image 2 forest background, pose, and lighting.

One-sentence brief:
A 30-second teleport-speed fight between Character A and Character B in a ruined sunlit temple courtyard, shot with crash zooms, whip pans, orbits, tracking follows, and impact shake. Both land hits and get visibly annoyed.

0–5s — stare-down:
Wide low-angle courtyard of cracked stone platforms, collapsed pillars, drifting dust, golden backlight. A left, B right, ten paces apart. Both already irritated. Slow push-in between them, then a hard snap to a split close-up of their eyes. A’s glare tightens. B’s mouth flattens. Hair and cloth move. No attack yet. No dialogue yet.

5–11s — first exchange:
A vanishes in a black-red afterimage and reappears at B’s flank with a crimson kinetic punch that leaves a shock-ring in the air. A says {Too slow.}
B dissolves into pale petals and wind, reappears above A, and slashes a cutting gust that scores the stone. B says {Try again.}
Camera: handheld crash-zoom into the punch, whip-pan to B’s vanish, orbit the empty space, then track them as they ricochet across platforms. Afterimage-smeared, snappy, not floaty. Sparks, dust, and torn petals hang in the light.

11–17s — first real tags:
A’s fist clips B’s marked shoulder. B jolts; eyes flash wide then narrow hard; lip curls; she is pissed it landed. She answers instantly. A wind-blade grazes A’s cheek and knocks a braid sideways. A’s eyebrows slam down, jaw clenches, she scoffs and rolls her shoulder like the hit was an insult. A says {Lucky.}
B’s eyes narrow. B says {Say that again.}
Rapid cuts: impact close-up on B’s shoulder, smash-cut to A’s cut cheek, low-angle two-shot as they blink-step past each other. Each teleport pops a shockwave in the dust.

17–24s — second wind, arena breaks:
They stop pretending it was a probe. A slams a platform; stone lifts and she rides the shockwave into a three-blink rush, fists leaving stacked crimson afterimages. B answers by spinning a petal cyclone that shears a pillar in half; fragments hang, then fall. They bounce off walls, columns, and floating slabs. No new dialogue. Camera: FPV chase through a teleport, whip to a low tracking shot across rubble, crash-zoom on a near-miss, then a rising orbit as the courtyard starts coming apart. Both faces stay readable: A snarling, B glaring, sweat and grit on skin.

24–30s — clash and hold:
They collide mid-air over the broken courtyard. A’s crimson burst slams into B’s spinning wind-petal cyclone. Camera spirals up around them, then slams into a close two-shot as they lock, faces inches apart, breathing hard, both annoyed rather than triumphant. Final hold: A snarling, B glaring, sparks and petals falling between them. End on that locked stare. Hold the last frame.

Maintain consistency:
Exactly two characters. Do not blend faces, hair, outfits, or body types. Keep A’s bandage arm, crop top, black braids, freckles, and scratches. Keep B’s pointed ears, blonde braids, fur trim, freckles, and blush. Same ruined temple courtyard the whole clip. Stylized cinematic 3D-anime, sharp faces, volumetric golden dust light, readable silhouettes during speed. No extra fighters, no text, no logos, no subtitles, no watermarks.

Audio:
(tense percussion and low strings; drums tighten at 11s; full surge at 17s; cut almost dry on the final lock)
<stone crack, air-rip teleports, afterimage whoosh, fist impact, wind-blade slice, cloth snap, pillar shear, grit skidding, mid-air boom>
A, sharp and cocky: {Too slow.}
B, clipped and annoyed: {Try again.}
A, scoffing: {Lucky.}
B, low and pissed: {Say that again.}
Courtyard wind and settling rubble under everything. No crowd. No narrator.
```

### How to adapt it

Replace both character references and their paired effect languages together. Preserve the five timed beats, readable silhouettes, two-character limit, and final locked stare.

<a id="infinite-castle-sword-rush"></a>

## Infinite-Castle Sword Rush Through a Demon Army

[![Painted Seedance 2.5 sword fighter battling a dense demon army](<https://pbs.twimg.com/amplify_video_thumb/2102580215591636992/img/iI2V5ZpbjMvp2qWj.jpg>)](<https://x.com/Chengzilhy/status/2102586866302345657>)

A 30-second painted-animation battle maps one swordsman's route through hundreds of enemies across ten tightly timed shots.

**Model:** Seedance 2.5

```text
【基础设定】

30秒，16:9。暗色幻想绘画动画风格，粗粝厚涂笔触、硬边明暗、概括色块、清晰人物剪影。

人物、敌群、建筑、武器统一为具有立体空间感的绘画动画。

高速运动中保持人物、刀锋、命中位置清楚。

头发、衣摆、碎木、灰烬具有真实惯性与重量。

整体色调以墨黑、灰青、旧木褐为主，人物暗红服装作为主要识别色。

【参考图绑定】
图片1= 战场建筑与空间结构参考。
仅采用悬空木平台、栏杆、回廊、阶梯、大殿及上下交错建筑关系。
图片2 = 敌群外观参考。
提取不同体型、皮肤、眼睛、獠牙、长爪、破旧衣物与异化轮廓，扩展为高密度敌潮。
图片3= 主角唯一身份与服装参考。
锁定脸型、长发、暗红外衣、敞领、腰带、宽裤、绑腿与鞋履。

【角色规则】

全片始终只有一名主角。
始终使用同一把实体刀，刀鞘固定腰侧。

右手主握，重斩时左手辅助同一刀柄。

人物面部克制，视线始终寻找下一处敌阵缺口。

所有攻击必须由真实身体动作驱动：

蹬地 → 转髋 → 挥刀 → 回腕 → 连续落步。

高速移动过程中人物本体始终连续可追踪。

禁止瞬移。

禁止实体分身。

禁止第二把刀。

【敌群规则】

敌人数百只。

中央平台、两侧回廊、远端阶梯与建筑阴影始终存在大量敌人。

前景使用肩背、头部、爪子压住画面边缘。

中景多排敌人包围人物移动路线。

背景敌群一直延伸至建筑深处。

敌人必须持续：

扑入、夹击、绕侧、封路、补位。

人物移动到哪里，新的敌群就从前方与侧翼压入。

人物经过之后才允许留下局部缺口。

24秒之前禁止大面积清空战场。

【核心战斗逻辑】

模式：

流光割草 + 极限连招密度。

全片以：

高速穿群
移动旋斩
横扫
反手斩
斜劈
短跃下劈

作为主要动作。

目标约26组短连招。

每组动作必须：

起手 → 接招 → 收招，无缝连接。

上一刀的收刀方向，直接成为下一组攻击的起始方向。

禁止攻击后站住重新摆姿势。

禁止三刀打一组然后停顿。

人物始终边打边移动。
【空间规则】
主平台远端阶梯 = 北。
入口 = 南。
左右两侧分别为东、西。
人物移动路线：

南部
→ 东侧
→ 中央
→ 西侧
→ 北部。

摄影机始终朝向尚未清除的敌群推进。

人物身前必须持续存在新的敌阵。

身后逐渐形成已经战斗过的路径。

空间、建筑地标、人物方向必须保持连续。

【镜头结构】

全片10个镜头段。

每段约3秒。

Shot 1｜0–3s

Wide，高位斜俯视追踪。

人物直接高速切入右侧敌群。

突入横斩
→ 反手回切
→ 移动回旋
→ 再次斜切进入下一排。

没有登场。

没有拔刀。

没有蓄力。
第一秒直接进入战斗。
Shot 2｜3–6s
FS，贴地侧前跟拍。
人物沿东侧战区高速向北推进。

连续横扫、反手斩、斜劈。

敌人从正面和侧面不断补入。

摄影机倒退跟拍，同时保留前方大量敌群。

Shot 3｜6–9s

Wide，升高斜俯视追踪。

人物从东侧切向平台中央。

连续三组移动旋斩。

每一次旋转都改变人物所在位置。

禁止原地转圈。

镜头展示人物身后逐渐形成的战斗路线。

Shot 4｜9–12s

FS，低位跟进。
人物进入中央最密集敌阵。
横扫
→ 反撩
→ 斜切
→ 上挑
→ 踏进压斩
→ 短跃下劈。
上层回廊与地面敌人同时压入。

人物必须同时应对上下两个方向。

Shot 5｜12–15s

FS，侧面短弧环绕。

人物折向西侧。

移动旋斩
→ 短跃
→ 下劈
→ 落地反手横扫。

完成后立即进入下一群敌人。

禁止落地停顿。

Shot 6｜15–18s

Wide，斜俯视折返追踪。

人物切进西侧敌阵后向北折返。

连续横斩、反斩、回旋压斩。

新的敌群从西侧回廊持续补入。

北侧阶梯始终作为远处空间地标。

Shot 7｜18–21s

MS → FS。

先短暂靠近人物。

展示一次真实的近距离攻防：

敌人双爪封路。

人物低身闪开攻击，同时转髋反切。

随后镜头立即拉开。

继续展示范围穿群动作。

禁止变成单挑。

Shot 8｜21–24s

Wide。
人物进入北部中央区域。
沿敌潮内部连续折线移动。
斜切进入
→ 回旋扫开
→ 反手穿出
→ 再改变方向。
东西两侧残余敌群继续向中心补位。
Shot 9｜24–27s

FS → Wide。

人物切入最后的大规模密集敌阵。

横扫
→ 反手斩
→ 压斩
→ 回旋
→ 反撩
→ 前冲斜劈。

镜头逐渐拉开。

明确展示人物已经打通的路线，与前方最后敌阵的位置。

Shot 10｜27–30s

FS → Wide。
人物冲入北阶前最后一批敌人。
27–28秒完成最后一组连续攻击。
28秒后停止攻击。

刀尖自然随收势垂下。

镜头缓慢后拉。

展示整个已经清理完成的平台。

主角成为画面中唯一站立的人物。

衣摆、长发、灰烬、碎屑继续自然运动。

【摄影规则】

摄影机必须跟随：

人物移动路线
攻击方向
敌群变化
空间地标。

远景与全景负责展示敌潮规模。

中近景只用于短暂展示身体动作与刀锋。

禁止长期贴脸。

禁止把范围战斗拍成逐个单挑。

禁止依靠疯狂切镜制造速度。

速度必须来自：

人物移动
敌群运动
身体动作
前景掠过
摄影机追踪。

【声音】

No dialogue.

No battle cries.

No subtitles.

No background music.

保留：
脚步声
挥刀声
撞击声
木构破裂声
环境空间回响。
```

A published 15-second prompt stages a golden retriever, a boy, and two puppies in a continuous backyard birthday story.

**Model:** Seedance 2.5

### Video prompt · `en`

```text
Create a 15-second photorealistic, heartwarming animal story in one continuous shot. Use a close-focusing 18mm wide-angle perspective with a fast, low, animal-height camera that smoothly rises into intimate human reactions without cutting. Maintain realistic animal movement, natural fur, believable object contact, and continuous spatial geography.

Set the sequence in one cozy backyard patio beside a small garden shed on a bright late-afternoon day. A wooden picnic table, two garden chairs, and a small covered dog bed occupy the same connected space.

The main animal is one golden retriever mother. The human character is a young boy wearing a mustard-yellow sweater. The important prop is one small round birthday cake with white frosting and a single blue candle.

0 to 2 seconds: Start extremely close to the cake on the picnic table. The mother dog reaches up, gently grips the cake box edge with her mouth, and pulls it down. The box lands softly on the patio. She immediately picks it up and trots away.

2 to 4 seconds: Race backward ahead of the dog as the boy notices. He follows with a surprised expression and says, “Hey, that’s for my birthday!”

4 to 6 seconds: Move alongside the dog as she passes between the two garden chairs. The camera stays low. The cake box bumps lightly against the ground with each step while the boy follows naturally behind.

6 to 8 seconds: Curve around the final chair and reveal the covered dog bed. The mother dog reaches it and carefully lowers the cake beside the bed. She releases the box and looks toward the puppies.

8 to 10 seconds: The first puppy slowly crawls forward from inside the bed and rests its chin beside the cake box. The boy kneels down, confused but smiling.

10 to 12 seconds: Rise slightly to include the boy, mother dog, and bed. The boy opens the box and discovers several tiny puppies gathered inside. He softly says, “Oh… you wanted a party too.”

12 to 14 seconds: Continue a close flowing orbit. The mother dog gently nudges the cake toward the puppies while the boy places it safely outside their reach. The puppies wiggle excitedly.

14 to 15 seconds: A second puppy suddenly pops its head beside the first and gives the blue candle one tiny curious sniff. The boy laughs quietly. End with the mother dog, two puppies, and boy sharing the warm moment.

Audio: Speak only the two quoted lines. Include soft paw steps, cardboard movement, quiet garden birds, puppy sounds, and the boy’s gentle laugh. No narration and no talking animals.

Continuity restrictions: One mother dog, exactly two puppies, one boy, one cake, one patio. No cuts, duplicated puppies, disappearing objects, magical movement, humanlike animal gestures, candle touching the puppies, or sudden location changes.
```

## What Can I Offer You? A Letterbox Pop-Out Comedy

[![What Can I Offer You? A Letterbox Pop-Out Comedy — Seedance 2.5 video preview](<https://pbs.twimg.com/amplify_video_thumb/2106393512597913600/img/Nht5nvI8YPv9arQF.jpg>)](<https://x.com/aimikoda/status/2106393688653922602>)

A magician offers gifts and steps across static letterbox bars in a nonverbal anime comedy with a published reference-based prompt.

**Model:** Seedance 2.5

### Video prompt · `en`

```text
Use @[char ref] as the exact character and style reference. Preserve her long pale-blue hair, oversized blue-and-orange pointed magician hat, orange-and-blue coat with its circular sleeve emblem, blue knee-high socks and chunky orange-and-blue sneakers. Keep the same angular painterly anime rendering, sharp graphic shapes and character proportions. Replace the background with clean pure white.

Create a playful, completely nonverbal comedy in one continuous shot. She offers increasingly surprising gifts to the viewer, reacts to each implied rejection through expressive facial acting, then decides to step out of the picture herself.

MAIN VISUAL GOAL:
An unmistakable OUT-OF-FRAME, POP-OUT effect. Her offered objects, hands, sleeves, hat and finally her legs and body visibly project OVER the black letterbox bars toward the viewer.

COMPOSITING ORDER, BACK TO FRONT:

1. White background and scene.
2. Two broad black letterbox bars at the top and bottom.
3. The foreground character and the objects she presents.

The white background is confined to the central picture window. The foreground character and offered objects are NOT confined to that window. Their silhouettes continue uninterrupted across its boundaries and onto the black bars. Their original colors remain fully visible when overlapping black.

STATIC BARS, MOVING FOREGROUND:
Both bars are completely static screen graphics. Keep their equal thickness, full width and exact screen position unchanged throughout. Their inner boundaries remain perfectly straight and horizontal.
Foreground movement only temporarily hides portions of the bars. The underlying bars never move or deform. Visible edge segments on either side of an overlap remain aligned on the same horizontal line. When an object withdraws, reveal the original unchanged black surface beneath it.
Keep black visible beside the overlaps. No bending, sliding, shaking, stretching, opening or impact reactions. The bars remain unchanged even during the final step out of the picture.

CAMERA AND PERFORMANCE:
Stationary camera, fixed wide-angle lens and level framing. She stays close and prominent throughout. Keep her face clearly visible inside the central picture window while her hands and gifts extend over the lower bar.
Her facial acting remains continuously active: eye contact, eyebrow changes, natural blinking, questioning head tilts, shifting smiles, pouts and expressive cheek movements. Connect every reaction to the current offer.
The viewer remains unseen and silent. Every rejection is IMPLIED entirely by her own reaction after looking into the lens. No viewer hands, camera nodding or external rejection signals.

STRICTLY NONVERBAL:

No dialogue, spoken words, whispering, narration, lip-sync or human vocalizations. No subtitles, captions or speech bubbles. She never mouths sentences. Mouth movement is limited to natural nonverbal expressions.
Follow this exact order: FLOWER, COFFEE, JEWEL, CAT, HERSELF.

FIRST OFFER, FLOWER:

She smiles warmly and retrieves a single flower from beyond a side edge of the screen. Extend it toward the viewer, bringing the flower, fingers and sleeve visibly over the lower black bar.
After a brief expectant look into the lens, her hopeful smile fades. One eyebrow rises, her head tilts and her eyes search the viewer’s face. Give the flower one small encouraging forward nudge, then accept the implied refusal with a tiny disappointed pout.
Retract the flower and visibly place it outside the side edge of the screen before retrieving the next object.

SECOND OFFER, COFFEE:

Reach offscreen and return with a coffee cup held securely by its handle. Her face brightens with renewed confidence.
Offer the cup close to the lens. Its silhouette and her sleeve clearly overlap the lower black bar while her face remains visible above it.
Her smile falters. Look at the cup, then back into the lens with raised eyebrows and pursed lips. A small resigned shoulder drop follows. Pull the cup back and set it offscreen without spilling.

THIRD OFFER, JEWEL:

Her eyes brighten with a sudden idea. Produce a large sparkling gemstone and present it in an open palm. The gemstone, fingers and sleeve project over the lower black bar.
Look proudly from the jewel to the viewer, expecting success. After the implied rejection, widen her eyes, lift both eyebrows and briefly part her lips in silent disbelief. Give the lens an incredulous stare, press her lips together and put the jewel offscreen.

FOURTH OFFER, CAT:
Retrieve a cute small cat from offscreen, supporting its body with both hands. Present it toward the lens, bringing its front paws, fluffy body and her hands visibly over the lower black bar.
Her expression becomes delighted and persuasive. The cat blinks and moves its paws naturally.
After another implied rejection, her delighted expression collapses into exaggerated disbelief. Look at the cat, then at the viewer, then back at the cat. Squint slightly and form a frustrated pout.
Turn slightly and give the cat a light, comical backward toss. The cat lands on its paws behind her and trots away. Keep this quick and playful.

FINAL OFFER, HERSELF:
Turn back to the viewer. Her frustration changes into a mischievous idea. Raise one index finger in a clear requesting-a-moment gesture, with the fingertip overlapping the upper black bar.
Lift one knee toward the lens and extend her sneaker OVER the lower black bar. The shoe grows large through foreshortening. Her leg crosses the picture boundary in front of the unchanged black surface.
Shift her weight forward and bring the rest of her body after it, as though stepping out of the framed image into the viewer’s space. Her coat overlaps the lower bar while her oversized hat overlaps the upper bar.
The bars remain perfectly straight and stationary beneath her. Her body simply renders in front of them. No opening, bending or displacement of either bar.
Finish close to the lens with open palms presenting herself, lifted eyebrows and a cheeky hopeful smile. Keep natural blinking, breathing and small facial movements through the ending.

OBJECT CONTINUITY:
One offered gift at a time. Show each retrieval, presentation and removal clearly. Objects enter and leave through a side edge of the output. No objects transforming into the next gift or disappearing while still held. Preserve consistent object shapes and natural hand contact.
Brisk natural real-time pacing with readable reactions. No slow motion, frozen expressions, distant retreats or camera movement. No warped bars, duplicated hands, costume changes or text.
Audio consists only of light prop sounds, fabric rustles, sneaker steps and a brief cat meow. No dialogue, human vocalizations or background music.
```

```text
@image1 A cinematic drone camera shot in three distinct staged movements following the numbered yellow guide path on the reference image, in this exact order: STAGE 1 — starting low near her feet, the camera tracks/dollies smoothly across and up along her leg toward her hip, a clear traveling crossing motion along the length of the leg. ## A Frame-Break Sword-and-Kick Performance
```

[![A Frame-Break Sword-and-Kick Performance — Seedance 2.5 video preview](<https://pbs.twimg.com/amplify_video_thumb/2106044251872067585/img/bMdFPshq7sNHiuNj.jpg>)](<https://x.com/aimikoda/status/2106044483863191748>)

An anime swordswoman projects her blade, hands and sneakers over fixed black letterbox bars in a close-range action sequence.

**Model:** Seedance 2.5

### Seedance 2.5 video prompt (author reply) · `en`

```text
Use @[char ref]￼as the exact character and style reference. Preserve her black hair and braids, oversized blue hooded jacket with cream graphics and orange trim, white cropped top, layered cream-and-orange pants, orange ribbons and white sneakers with black stripes and orange panels. Preserve her single sword with its black wrapped handle, gold guard and red tassel. Keep the same angular painterly anime rendering and blue background.

MAIN VISUAL GOAL:
An unmistakable OUT-OF-FRAME, POP-OUT effect. The character repeatedly projects beyond the central picture window, with her sword, hands, sneakers, hair and loose clothing visibly moving OVER the black letterbox bars toward the viewer.

COMPOSITING ORDER, BACK TO FRONT:
1. Background and scene.
2. Two broad black letterbox bars at the top and bottom.
3. The foreground character, including her sword, hands, sneakers and clothing.

The background is confined to the central picture window. The foreground character is NOT confined to that window. Her silhouette continues uninterrupted across its boundaries and onto the black bars. Blue sleeves, cream fabric, orange panels, sneakers and the silver blade remain fully visible when overlapping black.

STATIC BARS, MOVING CHARACTER:
Both bars are completely static screen graphics. Keep their equal thickness, full width and exact screen position unchanged throughout. Their inner boundaries remain perfectly straight and horizontal.

The character simply renders in front of them. Her movement temporarily hides portions of their black surface. The underlying bars never move or deform. Visible edge segments on either side of an overlap remain aligned on the same horizontal line. When she withdraws a limb, reveal the original unchanged black bar beneath it.

Keep black visible beside the overlapping body parts. No bending, sliding, shaking, stretching, opening or impact reactions in the bars.

The camera stays stationary with a fixed wide-angle lens. One continuous shot. She stays close and large in the composition, using short forward approaches, lateral pivots and compact recoveries. Never retreat deep into the background.

OPENING:
Already close to the viewer, she reaches toward the lens with her EMPTY hand while retaining the sword in her other hand.

Her fingertips visibly overlap the upper black bar. She makes one brisk diagonal lens-wiping gesture with her open palm, passing across the center and over the lower black bar. The hand and sleeve appear in front of both bars during the gesture. The bars remain unchanged beneath them.

The instant her palm clears the lens, she snaps into fast action without a pause.

CHOREOGRAPHY:
A diagonal sword slash passes close to the lens and visibly extends over the upper black bar. Reverse immediately into a tight turning cut. Her blue sleeve and loose cream-and-orange fabric sweep across the lower black surface.

She chambers a knee and fires a sharp FRONT KICK toward the viewer. The sneaker sole becomes large in the foreground and clearly overlaps the lower black bar, with black still visible beside it. Her shin connects continuously back to her body inside the central window. Retract immediately.

Plant the foot and pivot into a fast sword flourish crossing the upper bar. Continue into a compact SPINNING HEEL KICK. The sneaker sweeps close past the lens, its heel and sole projecting over the lower bar while her jacket and trouser fabric trail behind.

Keep alternating clear close-range overlaps: sword above the upper bar, sneaker over the lower bar, empty hand across a border, blue sleeve and cream fabric sweeping across black. Use fast connected combinations with crisp readable extensions and immediate recoveries.

Her clothing follows her body with strong momentum. Preserve the garment construction, patterned orange sections and cream folds. Fabric stays attached naturally and visibly covers the black surface without affecting its straight boundaries.

FINISH:
A final close-range sword extension crosses the upper black bar as her loose clothing flares over the lower bar. Resolve sharply into a confident martial-arts pose, retaining visible foreground overlap and quick natural follow-through.

The frame-break effect must come from the character visibly covering black areas outside the central picture window. Do not keep her entirely behind the bars. Do not simulate the effect by moving the bars or enlarging the window.

Fast real-time movement throughout, including the opening wipe. No slow motion, speed ramps, long windups or floating pauses. No camera movement, duplicated limbs or weapons, clothing morphing, text or background music. Sword whooshes, kick air bursts and fabric snaps only.
```

## A Broomstick Takeoff Seen From a Car Window

[![A Broomstick Takeoff Seen From a Car Window — Seedance 2.5 video preview](<https://pbs.twimg.com/amplify_video_thumb/2105193135978557440/img/yJ7Ho-C2FNCKQnd0.jpg>)](<https://x.com/johnAGI168/status/2105193274675798309>)

A handheld car-window view follows a broomstick rider from roadside running into sustained flight, with timed Chinese reactions.

**Model:** Seedance 2.5

### Seedance 2.5 video prompt (author post) · `zh`

```text
SEEDANCE 2.5｜车窗偶遇扫帚飞行
时长：17秒
画幅：9:16竖屏
手机随手拍摄质感，一镜到底，无字幕。

SUBJECT / 角色绑定：
​ 1 绑定【主角】，人物形象完全遵循角色卡，不另加外貌和穿着设定。

道具：
一把普通扫帚，细长木柄，后端为棕色枝条扎成的扫帚头。主角跨在扫帚杆上，木柄朝前，枝条束朝后；全程保持同一把扫帚，长度、形状和前后方向一致。

SHOT 1｜0—17秒｜车内拍摄者目击起飞

Environment：
多云白昼，灰白天空，郊外灰色沥青公路、白色车道线与金属护栏。护栏外是绿色农田、草地、零散树木和低层房屋，远处可见电塔。柔和自然光，普通日常公路环境。

Camera：
拍摄者坐在行驶的汽车内，举手机朝打开的侧窗外拍摄。开场保留左下方一部分外后视镜、底部车窗沿和少量窗框，建立真实车内视角。

汽车与主角近乎并行前进，手机持续追拍，存在轻微道路颠簸和自然手持抖动。前半段主要横向跟随主角，保持全身、扫帚和脚下路面同时可见。

主角超过汽车后，拍摄者仍从侧窗向道路前方转动手机，再逐渐上仰追踪。后视镜沿画面下缘退出，天空占比增大，公路保留在下方。全程不切镜，不切到车外机位，不突然变成航拍。

Style：
真实手机偶遇视频，普通曝光、自然色彩、轻微运动模糊。奇观来自人物和扫帚实际离地、持续悬浮与加速飞远。没有发光法阵、喷火、烟雾、魔法粒子或彩色拖尾。

Action / 连续动作：

0—1.5秒｜跨着扫帚跑，先跳一下
开场主角已经在公路边缘跨着扫帚奔跑，侧身朝画面左侧前进，与汽车并行。木柄向前，扫帚头拖在身后，但不扫地。

一只手先扶住身前杆身，另一只手随跑步自然摆动。约0.8秒，主角借跑步蹬地跃起，两腿短暂前后屈伸，随后双脚先后落地，继续跑动。这一次仍是普通跳跃。

1.5—4.8秒｜双手握稳，身体逐渐前倾
主角改为双手握住身体前方的扫帚杆，两肘逐渐弯曲，胸口慢慢压低。双腿仍交替蹬地，脚步与地面接触清楚可见。

汽车继续并行，拍摄者把主角稳稳留在画面中，保留脚与路面的位置关系，让观众清楚看见起飞前还在跑。

4.8—5.5秒｜真正离地
最后一次蹬地后，扫帚开始平稳承托身体。主角胸口进一步贴近杆身，两膝同时弯曲，小腿与双脚向臀部后下方收起。

双脚缓缓脱离路面，脚底与地面之间出现明确且持续增大的间隙。这次离地后不再落回地面。扫帚大致保持水平，人物与扫帚作为整体平稳上升。

5.5—10秒｜低空飞行，与汽车并排
主角伏低上身，双手持续握杆，两肘弯曲，双膝收在身后，双脚靠近，保持紧凑的飞行姿势。双腿停止跑步摆动。

扫帚沿道路方向低空飞行，与汽车并排保持数秒，离地高度缓慢增加。背景护栏和田野持续向后流动，人物悬空稳定，使“不再触地却仍然前进”的状态清楚可见。

拍摄者因吃惊出现一下轻微手抖，随即稳住手机，仍完整拍到主角和扫帚，不用猛烈甩镜遮住起飞。

10—13秒｜超过汽车，逐渐升高
主角与扫帚开始平滑加速，沿道路前方超过汽车，同时逐渐爬升。身体仍保持伏低握杆、屈膝收腿的姿势。

随着主角移动到车辆前方，画面自然从侧面视角转为偏后方视角。这个变化来自超车和摄影机追随，不让主角突然掉头。

拍摄者从侧窗向前转动手机，再抬高镜头。主角在画面中连续缩小，飞行路线清楚，没有瞬移。

13—17秒｜飞向远处天空
主角继续向道路前方上空飞远，速度进一步拉开与汽车的距离，逐渐缩成天空中的小剪影，再成为一个仍可辨认的小黑点。

摄影机持续自然上仰追踪，画面下方留有公路与远处地平线，最后天空占据大部分画面，小黑点仍留在上部。保持距离增加带来的连续缩小，不突然抹掉人物，不用闪光转场结束。

Performance：
主角专注向前，跑步时有真实蹬地和重心起伏；飞行后身体逐渐稳定。全程不向镜头讲话，不回应拍摄者，不做台词口型。

拍摄者不出镜，只通过声音和轻微手机动作表现反应：先觉得好笑，随后发现真的飞起来，语气突然变为惊讶。

AUDIO / 拍摄者同期画外音：

0.3—3.6秒：
同一位拍摄者在手机后方近距离说：
“快看快看，这怕不是是个傻子吧！”
前两个“快看”说得快，像在招呼车内同伴；后半句带一点忍不住的笑意，口语自然。

5.4—8.4秒：
确认主角双脚持续悬空后，拍摄者脱口而出：
“我去，我去，真的飞起来了！”
第一个“我去”短促、突然；停顿一小下，第二个“我去”音调提高；“真的飞起来了”带着明显难以置信的惊讶，声音稍大但仍是车内随手录制的感觉。

两句话均来自画外拍摄者，不是主角发声，不采用播音腔或后期解说腔。保留车内低沉行驶声、轮胎路噪和开窗风声，飞远后留一点惊讶的呼吸声，不追加其他台词，不配音乐。

Constraints：
只绑定一位人物主角，拍摄者始终在画外。
先有跳起再落地，随后才持续离地，两个阶段必须区分。
第二句惊呼在真正悬浮之后出现。
跑步阶段双脚交替触地；飞行阶段双膝后收，双脚不再蹬地或在空中跑步。
扫帚始终跨在两腿之间，双手握杆位置连续，人物不能与扫帚脱离。
车辆、道路、人物位移与镜头方向保持一致。
结尾通过飞远而缩小，保留远处小黑点。

NEGATIVE：
人物换脸，穿着漂移，多余手脚，扫帚复制或变形，悬空跑步，突然瞬移，人物主动掉头，魔法光效，夸张甩镜，切镜，主角对口型，字幕，水印。
```

Replace the character card with your own subject. Preserve the distinction between a normal jump and sustained takeoff, and keep the camera inside the car.

```text
Create a 30-second sequence using Image1 as the anchor for the cat’s exact fluffy design, exaggerated expression language and painterly anime rendering. The cat is having impossibly intense zoomies and must feel far beyond ordinary fast—so fast that in half a second it can cross an entire room, reappear on a cabinet, disappear again and already be drifting across a rug in another part of the house before the viewer fully processes the first move. The house is its racetrack. It tears down a hallway, hits a rug and goes into a full sideways drift with claws carving through the carpet, then uses that drift energy to slingshot onto a sofa. It sprints across the backrest, rebounds off cushions, launches onto a side table, jumps to the top of a cabinet, races along the cabinet edge, kicks objects into the air and drops back down into another full-speed lap without ever feeling like it paused. It should repeatedly run across rugs, skid on them so hard they bunch and twist, jump onto sofas, use armrests as stepping points, scramble across cabinet tops and shelf edges, then dive back to floor level and instantly redirect again. The speed must be conveyed through impossible re-entry timing: the camera catches only fragments, impacts and consequences, while the cat is already somewhere else. A plant starts falling in one room and before it lands the cat has already blasted through the kitchen and returned to the same hallway. Cushions are still airborne from one pass when the cat ricochets through the frame again from another direction. Show repeated routes with escalating destruction: rugs dragged out of alignment, sofa fabric clawed, small objects swept off surfaces, frames tilted, papers tornadoing through the air, scattered debris rolling across the floor. Use ultra-fast cinematic language: low-lens chase shots that immediately lose the cat, whip-pans that reacquire it on top of furniture, split-second macro flashes of claws catching rug fibers, hind legs kicking off polished wood, paws flattening into upholstery, eyes going feral and mouth open in manic excitement. Keep one cat only, no clones, no teleportation—just absurdly continuous real movement at a speed that feels almost impossible. In the final beat, after one last catastrophic rug drift and a cabinet-to-sofa-to-floor combo that wrecks half the room, the cat suddenly lands right in front of the lens and freezes into an absurdly cute pose, perfectly composed and innocent, surrounded by total household devastation.
```

```text
Night. A young woman is so lost in the music in her headphones that she floats off her bed. Her friend opens the stuck bedroom door and freezes in shock. Dreamy, surreal, weightless.

CHARACTERS

Main character (@img1): A young woman in her mid-20s with a soft round face, fair freckled skin, rosy cheeks, green-hazel eyes, and glossy nude-pink lips. She has a small gold nose ring and a thin gold necklace with a red cherry pendant. Her long soft-wavy caramel-brown hair has a center part and blue-grey face-framing streaks. She wears an oversized cream knit sweater with sage-green stripes, loose light-blue jeans, and over-ear headphones. She is barefoot. Her face 100% matches @img1.
Friend: A young woman in her mid-20s with an oval face, sun-kissed skin with visible pores and light freckles, light blue eyes, and slightly uneven natural brows. She has minimal makeup, a soft nude lip, and long wavy golden-blonde hair with darker roots and flyaway strands. She looks real and approachable. She wears a black crop top, a light-wash denim jacket, high-waisted black jeans, and white sneakers. She speaks with a casual, upbeat young American voice.

LOCATION: THE BEDROOM
A typical American bedroom for a young woman in her 20s, medium-to-large but cozy and lived-in. A queen bed with rumpled white sheets and a soft beige throw sits in the center, with open floor on both sides. A wooden nightstand with a small warm lamp stands at the head of the bed, and warm fairy lights are strung on the wall above it. A window with sheer curtains lets in cool blue moonlight. There are a few framed prints and posters, a small desk with a mirror, a plant, a rug, wooden floors, and clothes draped on a chair. It is nighttime and moody but readable, with gentle shadows and no crushed blacks.

LOCATION: THE DOOR AND HALLWAY
A closed white wooden panel door with a round brass handle, set in a white frame on a plain wall that matches the room. A light switch is beside the door, and a small hook holds a tote bag. A thin line of warm hallway light glows under and around the door. Beyond it is a narrow hallway with beige walls and a warm ceiling light. The door side of the room is dark and low-key, lit only by a faint warm 2700K glow from the bedside lamp and a faint cool blue moonlight tint.

FIRST FRAME
Extreme close-up of the round brass doorknob, with the white door panel soft behind it and a thin line of warm hallway light along the edge.

FORMAT MODE
Timed multishot, 5 cuts. Cuts only at the specified points, and the camera does not cut on its own.

OPTICS

0.0–2.5s: ECU, 12°
2.5–4.5s: CU, 29°
4.5–9.0s: WS, 47°
9.0–12.0s: MS, 47°
12.0–15.0s: tight CU, 29°

No drift mid-segment.

CAMERA

Cuts 1 and 2: locked off inside the bedroom, facing the door.
Cut 3: low angle from the foot of the bed with a slow, smooth glide, ending slightly looking up at her.
Cuts 4 and 5: locked top-down, straight overhead.

ACTION

0.0–2.5s, CUT 1: Extreme close-up of the brass doorknob. It turns halfway and catches, jiggles twice, then rattles harder as the door thumps in its frame. A muffled voice calls through the door: "Hey, you in there?" The latch clicks, and the door swings open quickly as warm hallway light sweeps across the frame.
2.5s HARD CUT
2.5–4.5s, CUT 2: Close-up of the friend's face in the open doorway, with the lit hallway soft behind her and a few strands of hair out of place. Her casual expression drops instantly: her jaw falls open, her eyes widen, her brows shoot up, and she stops breathing. She stares slightly past the camera at something above the bed.
4.5s HARD CUT
4.5–9.0s, CUT 3: Wide, low side angle on the bed. The main character lies flat on her back on the rumpled sheets, eyes closed, headphones on, hair spread on the pillow, one finger tapping softly on the sheet. Her body lifts off the mattress, perfectly horizontal and slow, as if the music is carrying her. The sheets rise slightly and settle. She ends up floating about one meter above the bed, eyes closed, with a faint smile.
9.0s HARD CUT
9.0–12.0s, CUT 4: Top-down medium shot from head to waist. Her eyes snap open. She rises slowly toward the camera, arms stiff and slightly out from her sides, fingers spread, chest heaving. The bed is visible far below and growing more distant.
12.0s HARD CUT
12.0–15.0s, CUT 5: Top-down tight close-up, her face nearly filling the frame as she nears the ceiling. Her eyes are wide, her lips parted, and her breathing is rapid and shallow with flaring nostrils. Her brows are raised and pulled together, and her jaw trembles slightly.

PERFORMANCE

Friend: casual impatience, then silent, total shock with her mouth hanging wide open and a tiny chin tremble.
Main character: peaceful and serene with eyes closed, then silent panic once her eyes open.
Natural human eyes with matte, realistic irises, soft wet shine, and one small soft reflection in each eye. Pore-level skin realism with visible freckles on both.

PHYSICS

The stuck knob rattles with small metallic jolts, and the door shudders, then swings free with momentum.
The floating woman is weightless, but her hair and blue-grey streaks hang down with gravity and sway slowly. Her sweater hem and jeans drape downward, and her headphones stay firmly on her head.

LIGHTING

Dark, low-key, and cinematic, with soft shadows and no crushed blacks.
Hallway light rims the friend's hair and shoulders from behind. Her face is lit by a dim warm 2700K lamp glow and a faint cool blue tint.
Warm lamp glow and fairy-light sparkles light the floating woman from below and the side, with cool blue moonlight outlining her from the other side. Faces are always readable.

AUDIO
Knob rattling, door thumping, the muffled line "Hey, you in there?", the latch clicking, and the door swinging open. Then near silence with soft room tone and a faint rustle of sheets as she lifts. In the last cut, her hard, shaky breathing is close and loud. No music.

STYLE
Photoreal, cinematic, dreamy and surreal, fine film grain, soft highlight roll-off.

OUTPUT SETTINGS
4:3 aspect ratio, real-time, 15 seconds.

POSITIVE LOCKS

The friend appears only in cuts 1 and 2. Her only words are "Hey, you in there?", heard muffled before the door opens, and she is silent in the close-up with her mouth wide open.
The main character is the only person in cuts 3 to 5 and says nothing. She floats face up in every cut with her headphones on the whole time.
Her face matches @img1 exactly, including the blue-grey face-framing streaks, nose ring, and cherry necklace. The friend's look and the bedroom stay consistent in every cut.
```

## A Tunnel Chase Match-Cuts Into a Romantic Beach Memory

[![A Tunnel Chase Match-Cuts Into a Romantic Beach Memory](<https://pbs.twimg.com/amplify_video_thumb/2106808100728852480/img/V40Nwoa3vjKbgl-I.jpg>)](<https://x.com/Just_sharon7/status/2106808592523571360>)

A thriller links a frightening tunnel pursuit to a warm beach memory through matching hand gestures and an emotional reunion.

**Model:** Seedance 2.5

### Video prompt from the author post · `en`

```text
Create a 27-second ultra-realistic cinematic psychological thriller sequence with a dramatic transition between a terrifying present moment and a beautiful romantic memory.

Overall visual style: premium Hollywood psychological thriller, photorealistic live action, realistic skin texture and pores, natural hair movement, believable fabric physics, dramatic practical lighting, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, anamorphic cinematic composition, realistic motion blur, strong emotional acting. 2.39:1 widescreen. No text, no subtitles, no logos.

CHARACTERS

Woman: Young woman in her mid-20s with long dark-brown hair, expressive brown eyes and natural realistic features. She wears an elegant sleeveless fitted black dress. Keep her face, hairstyle, clothing and body proportions perfectly consistent.

Man: Young man in his late 20s, tall and lean, dark hair, wearing an elegant white dinner jacket, white shirt, black bow tie and black trousers.

In the frightening present-day scenes, the man appears severely transformed: his exposed hand and portions of his skin are dark, charred and corpse-like, with rough burned texture and unnatural gray-black fingers. Keep the effect cinematic rather than excessively graphic.

00:00–00:06 — TERRIFYING CHASE

Open inside a long underground pedestrian tunnel with cold turquoise-green fluorescent lighting, tiled walls, concrete ceiling beams and repeating rectangular ceiling lights disappearing into the distance.

The woman runs desperately toward camera.

Her long hair whips violently behind her. She is breathing hard, terrified and repeatedly looking over her shoulder.

Behind her, the man in the white dinner jacket runs after her.

Use a fast backward tracking camera, staying directly in front of the woman. Alternate briefly between a tight frightened facial close-up and a wider side-tracking shot showing both characters sprinting through the tunnel.

The man stretches one arm toward her.

Cut to an extreme close-up of his horrifying blackened, damaged hand getting closer and closer to her bare shoulder.

Just before his fingers touch her—

00:06–00:12 — MATCH CUT INTO THE MEMORY

Make a seamless visual match cut.

The frightening dark hand instantly becomes the man's normal healthy hand, positioned in exactly the same place.

The cold turquoise tunnel transforms into a beautiful sunset beach.

Warm golden sunlight floods the frame.

The woman is now laughing happily while running barefoot beside the ocean. Her black dress flows naturally in the sea breeze.

The man is completely normal and handsome again, still wearing his elegant white dinner jacket.

He playfully reaches toward her shoulder while chasing her.

She turns around laughing.

They run together along the shoreline, holding hands and smiling.

Golden sun reflects across the ocean behind them. Wind moves their hair and clothing. Their body language shows that this was once a deeply happy relationship.

Use dreamy handheld tracking, warm backlighting, natural lens flare and intimate close-ups.

The sequence should briefly feel like a completely different film: romantic, nostalgic, peaceful and genuinely joyful.

00:12–00:13 — SNAP BACK TO REALITY

Without warning, smash-cut back to the cold underground tunnel.

Same framing.

Same reaching-hand composition.

But his hand is once again dark, damaged and frightening.

All warm colors disappear instantly.

Return to harsh cyan-green fluorescent lighting and deep shadows.

00:13–00:20 — CORNERED

The woman reaches the end/side of the tunnel and backs against the tiled wall.

She has nowhere left to run.

She suddenly pulls out a small black knife and holds it defensively with both hands.

Her hands shake badly.

She is crying, breathing rapidly and staring at the approaching man.

Camera slowly pushes toward her face.

Her expression changes from pure terror to confusion and recognition.

The man approaches slowly instead of attacking.

Show an extreme shallow-focus shot of his damaged hand cautiously reaching toward her.

She raises the knife—

but cannot bring herself to use it.

Tears fill her eyes.

00:20–00:27 — EMOTIONAL REVEAL

The man steps close.

Instead of hurting her, he suddenly embraces her tightly.

She freezes for a fraction of a second.

Then recognition overwhelms her.

The knife lowers out of frame.

She wraps both arms around him.

She begins sobbing uncontrollably against his shoulder, gripping the back of his white jacket as if she has finally found someone she believed she had lost.

Hold an intimate close-up on her face over his shoulder.

Her makeup is slightly disturbed by tears. Her breathing is uneven. Her hands tremble against his back.

The frightening figure is revealed emotionally as someone she once deeply loved.

Slowly push closer to her crying face and her hand clutching his jacket.

End without explaining whether the man is real, dead, imagined, remembered, or something supernatural.

The audience should be left with the unsettling feeling that the terrifying chase and the beautiful beach memory are connected.

CAMERA + EDITING

Use energetic tracking during the chase, intimate handheld movement during the beach memory, and slower controlled push-ins during the emotional ending.

The most important visual transition is:

charred hand reaching toward shoulder → identical composition of healthy hand reaching toward shoulder on the beach → charred hand again in the tunnel.

The match cuts must feel extremely precise so the past and present visually overlap.

Maintain perfect character identity and wardrobe continuity throughout.

Realistic skin pores, natural facial asymmetry, individual hair strands, genuine tears, realistic wet eyes, subtle sweat, natural blinking and breathing. Avoid plastic skin, beauty filters, CGI-looking faces, warped hands, extra fingers, inconsistent clothing, identity changes, exaggerated horror gore or artificial expressions.
```

### How to adapt it

Keep character clothing and the reaching-hand composition consistent. Change lighting and setting across the match cut, then slow the camera for the emotional reveal.

Three depth layers: the edge of the bench and the water bottle in the near foreground, slightly out of focus; Mila in the middle; the dumbbell rows and windows behind her. Light comes only from warm ceiling downlights fading into the distance in a line above her. The background stays one to two stops darker than her skin; her glowing, sweaty skin is the brightest thing in the frame. Warm taupe and graphite surroundings; a thin warm rim of light from the downlights separates her black outfit from the dark background. Background life: far outside the window, car lights slowly drift past. Lived-in detail: chalk on the bar, scuffs on the floor. No other people, no mirrors, no readable text, no screens, no logos. The rack, bench, bottle and dumbbell rows stay in the same places in every shot.

```text
CAMERA
Authentic casual footage captured with an older consumer digital camera. Handheld DV 16mm camcorder aesthetic. Her friend, unseen, operates the camera and is clearly distracted by her. Natural hand shake, crooked framing, late corrections, delayed autofocus after reframing. Every time the camera gets caught, it jerks guiltily back up to her face. Avoid gimbal-like movement. Her face and the key action stay in the centre and upper two thirds of the frame.

LOOK AND LIGHT
Soft digital-tape look, faint noise, mild compression, slightly muted colours, restrained contrast, imperfect white balance. Low-key image: warm downlights shape her body from above with a soft rim along the black fabric; roughly half the frame stays in soft shadow. Modest depth of field, background softly out of focus but recognizable. Real skin: visible pores, fine baby hairs, a fine sweat sheen catching the light, never oily or plastic. Real black fabric knit with soft highlights where it stretches. Available light from the ceiling fixtures only, no studio lighting, no beauty filters, no glossy commercial finish.

MOTION
Fluid, natural, real-time human motion with real weight and momentum. Every action has preparation, action and follow-through: the body settles, ponytail and fabric keep moving a moment after she stops. Her eyes move first, then her head, then her shoulders. Not every body part moves in synchronization. She is never frozen: she breathes visibly, blinks, shifts her weight. A small breath before each line, body moving while talking. No frozen frames, no time stalls, no looping, no slow or sped-up motion, no stiff posing.

BODY MOVEMENT
Barbell squat: feet slightly wider than hips, toes out. She inhales at the top, sits her hips back and down, knees over toes, torso leaning slightly forward, then drives up through her heels with a short effort exhale, glutes and thighs tightening, plates wobbling and clinking, ponytail swinging a beat behind her. Bodyweight squat: hands clasped loosely at her chest, same mechanics, chest rising with each breath. Walking away: hips shift naturally over each supporting foot, ponytail swaying.

ACTION AND TIMING
00:00–00:05.5 — SHOT 1, REAR, camera at hip height two metres behind her. She completes one slow, heavy squat and rises (the faint white hint visible through the stretched black fabric only at the very bottom); the camera slowly zooms in on her glutes and lingers too long. At 00:03.0 she racks the bar on the hooks with BOTH hands, plates clink and settle. At 00:04.0, still facing away, she glances back over her RIGHT shoulder straight into the lens, raises one eyebrow, slow knowing smirk. The camera jerks upward to her face. No dialogue.
00:05.5–00:10.5 — SHOT 2, FRONT, camera at chest height, framing head to mid-thigh. She does slow bodyweight squats facing the lens. The frame slowly drifts down toward her chest; she catches it, tilts her head, a small smirk: "Eyes up here." The camera jerks back up to her face. She keeps squatting, warm and clear: "Rule one: sit back, then squeeze at the top."
00:10.5–00:15.0 — SHOT 3, CLOSE, from slightly below, head and chest. She picks up the water bottle from the bench with her RIGHT hand and takes one slow, gentle sip from the side, the bottle NEVER covering her eyes, eyes softly half-closed for a moment. She lowers the bottle to chest height, presses her lips together, gives a sweet breathless smile into the lens: "Your turn." At 00:12.8 she turns and walks back toward the rack, bottle still in her RIGHT hand. The camera immediately drifts down to her glutes again. At 00:14.0, without turning around, she raises her LEFT hand over her LEFT shoulder and points one finger straight up. Hold this for the final 0.7 seconds.

SOUND
Natural gym sound only: her breathing and short exhales, plates clinking, the bar settling into the hooks, shoes squeaking on rubber, ventilation hum, a soft swallow after the sip, her footsteps walking away. Only Mila speaks, each line once, warm, slightly breathy American delivery, clear lip-sync, recorded by the same camera microphone. No music. Finish the last line before 00:12.8.

CONTINUITY
One woman, one loaded barbell, one rack, one bench, one water bottle. The bar stays on the hooks after 00:03.0. The bottle stays on the bench until her RIGHT hand picks it up and stays in her RIGHT hand to the end. The final gesture is made only with her LEFT hand. Her outfit stays black in every shot. She does NOT touch her face. No other people appear.

PHYSICAL REALISM
The barbell has real weight, plates wobble with real mass, water moves inside the bottle. Hair and fabric lag behind her body. Feet stay on the ground. Five fingers per hand, natural joints. No extra fingers, fused hands, duplicated limbs, distorted anatomy, floating or disappearing objects, teleportation or sudden transformations. No nudity. No text, captions, logos or watermarks. She is an adult.

FINAL FEEL
A real late-night leg day filmed by a hopelessly distracted friend who keeps getting caught: sweaty, sweet, teasing and funny. Not a commercial. Not a fashion shoot. Not a music video. Not polished influencer content.
```

### Author-published video prompt · `en`

```text
[First-Frame.png] Create a 20-second vertical 9:16 image-to-video film, using the supplied image as the exact first frame and matching final frame. One continuous camera journey through the room, with macro detail, a gradual emotional reveal, an orbit behind the central figure and a seamless return.

Build the supplied scene as complete 3D geometry while preserving its Renaissance oil-painted appearance. The table stands in real space, the tablecloth drapes over its edges, the food and vessels sit on its surface, and every figure has a fully dimensional body beneath their robes. As the camera passes around them, reveal the sides and rear surfaces hidden from the opening viewpoint. Retain the original brushwork, warm earthy colours, soft daylight and expressive faces.

IDENTIFY AND PRESERVE THE FIGURES

The central figure sits at the middle of the table. He has long wavy brown hair, a full brown beard and downcast, calm eyes. He wears a deep red robe with a rich blue mantle draped across his left shoulder and lap. His right hand rests palm-down on the tablecloth at the left of the frame; his left hand lies open, palm-up, beside a small glass of red wine.

To his right (left of frame) sits a young apostle with long golden-brown hair, a green mantle over a red garment, his sorrowful gaze turned toward the centre. In front of him, a balding older man with a dark beard, wearing red and blue, leans in with a pointing gesture. A partly visible figure with curly hair sits at the far left edge.

To his left (right of frame) a man with thick black curly hair and a dark beard, in a blue robe, turns to speak with a grey-bearded elder in an olive-green robe at the right edge, who raises both hands in an open, questioning gesture.

Keep every pose, gesture, gaze direction and costume exactly as in the reference. No figure moves.

THE ROOM AND TABLE

A dark coffered wooden ceiling. A grey back wall with three tall windows opening onto a sunlit Tuscan landscape of blue hills, cypress trees, terracotta villas and a bell tower. Dark blue and gold damask panels on both side walls.

A long table covered in white linen with a visible grid of fold creases, hanging almost to the floor. On it: scattered bread rolls and crumbs, pewter plates, a central plate of fish, the small glass of red wine, a bowl of green olives, a plate of red and green grapes at the right, a blue-and-white decorated bowl with bread at the left, and a dark glazed ceramic jug at the far left. Wooden trestle legs and the hems of robes are visible below the cloth.

0–3 SECONDS — ENTER OVER THE BREAD

Begin on the exact supplied image for approximately half a second.

The camera then flies forward into the room and descends toward the bread roll resting on the tablecloth just left of centre. Pass macro-close above it.

Reveal the roll's rounded volume, cracked golden crust, flour-dusted ridges and the small crumbs scattered around it, each casting a tiny shadow on the linen. The nearest crust passes softly out of focus beneath the lens as the camera glides on.

The tablecloth has physical relief: woven threads, raised fold creases and shallow dips where objects press into it. The bread falls behind the moving camera while the central figure stays fixed farther into the room. This changing perspective establishes real depth immediately.

3–7 SECONDS — GLIDE ACROSS THE TABLE TO THE WINE

Travel low and smoothly across the linen toward the centre of the table, skimming past the rim of the fish plate. Reveal the plate's worn pewter edge, its curved depth and the painted fish resting inside.

Continue to the small glass of red wine. Curve partly around it at macro distance, revealing the thickness of the glass, the flat surface of the wine, and daylight from the windows refracting through it as a soft red glow on the cloth.

The glass crosses the near foreground, the open palm-up hand appears just beyond it, and the back wall shifts more slowly behind. Maintain forward momentum throughout.

7–10 SECONDS — RISE ALONG THE OPEN HAND AND MANTLE

Rise past the open hand, revealing the gentle curve of the fingers, the creases of the palm and its weight resting on the cloth.

Continue upward along the blue mantle where it falls across his lap and left shoulder. Travel close to the fabric without touching it. Show the painted texture, the deep blue folds as dimensional surfaces: raised crests catch the window light, undersides fall into shadow, and the red robe shows beneath the mantle's edge.

The blue fabric passes beside the lens as his face comes into view above.

10–13 SECONDS — REVEAL THE CENTRAL FACE

Curve inward and slightly upward toward his face.

Approach a close view of his lowered eyes, calm brow, nose and the soft strands of his beard and hair. Preserve the exact face from the reference. Reveal the three-dimensional shape of the cheekbones and brow, and the subtle painted texture of the skin, fully connected to his neck and shoulders.

Ease the camera's speed for approximately one second while continuing a gentle sideways drift. Let the stillness and quiet sorrow register. He does not move; the emotion comes from discovering the expression already present in the painting.

13–17 SECONDS — ORBIT BEHIND HIM TO THE WINDOW

Continue past the outside of his face, over his blue-draped left shoulder, and orbit smoothly behind him into the narrow space between his back and the central window.

Reveal the back of his long wavy hair, the rear folds of the blue mantle and red robe, and the thickness of his shoulders beneath the fabric. His shoulder passes close beside the lens as a soft foreground shape.

Turn gently to look past him through the central window: the sunlit Tuscan hills, cypresses and villas gain real depth, the far hills hazy and the near trees sharper. Then continue the arc so the view swings back over his other shoulder, revealing from behind the backs of the apostles' heads, the young apostle's green mantle, and the whole table spread out before them toward where the viewer began.

17–20 SECONDS — RETURN TO THE ORIGINAL COMPOSITION

Rise and retreat in one smooth arc over the table, passing above the grey-bearded elder's raised open hands at the right, then curving back onto the opening camera axis.

Reveal all figures again in their exact positions. The bread, plates, wine glass, olives, grapes, decorated bowl and ceramic jug settle back onto the table as in the supplied image. The coffered ceiling, three windows and damask walls realign with the frame.

Gently decelerate into the exact opening viewpoint, lens perspective, framing and lighting. End on a frame matching the supplied image so the next repetition flows directly into the opening movement.

CAMERA, STYLE AND CONTINUITY

Use one uninterrupted physical camera path: over the bread, across the table to the wine, up the open hand and blue mantle, to the central face, around behind him to the window, back over his shoulder and out to the original wide composition.

Use natural motion blur and shallow depth of field during macro passes. Transfer focus smoothly to the next detail along the route. Foreground objects pass the lens because the camera moves around them; no figure changes pose, blinks, speaks or moves toward the camera.

Maintain one coherent room with stable geometry and consistent warm daylight from the windows. Hidden surfaces belong to the existing figures, clothing, table and walls and match their visible design. Preserve the oil painting's brushwork, canvas texture and colour at every scale.

No cuts, crash zooms, dissolves, flat canvas flyovers, wall-relief effects, scene morphing, additional people, new props, extra food, text or watermark.
```

```text
7.0秒左右：女主乙抬眉瞪眼、张嘴笑。
7.4–7.7秒：抽离并甩回女主甲。

镜头贴近幅度和表情明显增强，仍能看清每次左右运动的连续过程。

7.7–9.1秒｜最后一次怼近女主甲

她的脸斜着铺满画面，额头和脸侧部分出框。
她持续大张嘴、露齿，眼睛在瞪大和笑眯之间变化，已经被这个自拍视频逗得停不下来。

这次比前几次多停一小会儿，手机在近处短促晃动，保持她的脸可见。
不增加吐舌、翻白眼或手部动作。

8.8秒左右开始稍稍抽离，随后连续右甩，9.1秒到达女主乙面前。

9.1–10.0秒｜女主乙贴脸大笑收尾

镜头甩到女主乙后立即贴近。
她张嘴露齿大笑，眼睛随着笑容变窄，脸占据几乎整个竖幅。
保持近距离广角透视和轻微手持晃动。

直接在她的大笑脸上结束。
不拉远，不切双人同框，不回到女主甲，不做静态定格。

CONSTRAINTS
两张角色卡分别锁定两人的面容、发型、服装与配饰，快速甩镜中也不串脸、不换装。
两人全程躺在原来的枕头上。
脸的大小变化来自摄影机靠近或退开，人物五官不自行变形。
前半段表情相对收着，4.7秒后才明显放开。
全片约六轮“女主甲→女主乙”，结尾必须落在女主乙。

NEGATIVE
改变角色卡服装，替换配饰，发型漂移，换装
硬切，剪辑正反打，分屏，闪白，淡入淡出
人物换位，坐起，翻滚，突然出现第三人
手机入镜，持机手入镜，交接手机
换脸，串脸，面部融合，液化变形，五官漂移
僵硬微笑，恐惧表演，疼痛表演，哭泣
额外吐舌，翻白眼，抓衣服，互相推搡
稳定器滑行，电影慢推，慢动作，过度景深虚化
暗调灯光，浓重黄光，过度磨皮，塑料皮肤
结尾拉远，双人合影收尾，女主甲收尾，定格
旁白，额外对白，字幕，贴纸，水印，品牌标志
```

## A Cyborg Becomes Mist During a Shibuya Crossing Battle

[![A Cyborg Becomes Mist During a Shibuya Crossing Battle](<https://pbs.twimg.com/amplify_video_thumb/2110574466673909760/img/y5IQYYqxIj2WiNV2.jpg>)](<https://x.com/tokyo_Valentine/status/2110575409423323647>)

A timed action prompt pits a yellow cyborg against a skeletal king, with mist transformation and impact-driven glitches.

**Model:** Seedance 2.5

### Author reply video prompt · `en`

```text
Create a 15-second, 16:9 cinematic action video set at Shibuya Scramble Crossing, Tokyo, at night.

CHARACTER REFERENCES
Use only the two character reference images for identity and design.
Reference 1: Character A, the yellow-and-black mechanical skull cyborg.
Reference 2: Character B, the towering skeletal king wearing crimson robes.

A: Approximately 180 cm tall. Chipped yellow industrial armor, horizontal pointed head extensions, skull mask, black breathing hoses, intricate mechanical joints, spiked shoulders, chains, and torn dark fabric.
B: Approximately 260 cm tall. Huge branching black antlers, ornate crown, glowing red eyes, exposed skeletal ribcage, elaborate tattered crimson robes, and an ornate staff.

Preserve their exact silhouettes, proportions, materials, colors, and accessories. Create fluid full-body combat animation and dynamic camera movement. Maintain their height difference.

VISUAL STYLE
Photorealistic live-action cinematography, spectacular destruction VFX, and explosive shonen battle intensity.

Extreme acceleration, brutal close-range punches, powerful blocks, violent recoil, and physical impacts that destroy roads and buildings.

Combine tactile physical realism with aggressive digital corruption: RGB separation, horizontal signal tearing, datamoshing trails, pixel fragmentation, scanline interference, and dirty electronic noise.
Keep the choreography and decisive impacts clearly readable.

GLITCH AND NOISE DIRECTION
Make the effects react to the action.

On punch contact: short, violent RGB displacement around the fighters, horizontal image shearing, and a burst of coarse digital static radiating from the impact.

During extreme acceleration: stretched datamoshing trails and fragmented afterimages attached to moving limbs. These are visual motion trails, not separate characters.

Around the reality fracture: unstable scanlines, displaced image strips, crawling pixel noise, and flickering red-white edges.
During mist transformation: mechanical surfaces break into tiny yellow particles, black vapor, and granular signal noise. The transition remains continuous and visibly follows the body.

During the final destruction: physical fragments mix with pixel breakup, corrupted motion trails, and a dense burst of electronic interference.

Use the strongest corruption in brief bursts, followed by clear moving imagery. Keep physical motion flowing through every effect. Avoid prolonged freezes or static poses.

LOCATION
An empty, rain-soaked Shibuya Scramble Crossing. Recognizable diagonal zebra crossings, giant LED billboards, QFRONT-style architecture, and surrounding shopping towers.

Wet asphalt reflects cold city lights, yellow sparks, and crimson energy.

Billboards briefly malfunction in response to nearby shockwaves: distorted footage, broken scanlines, and signal noise.

Keep the fight within this intersection. Environmental damage accumulates and remains visible.

0–3 SECONDS — EXPLOSIVE COLLISION
Begin immediately in motion.
An ultra-low camera races along the white crossing stripes as both fighters launch toward each other.

A’s fist crashes into B’s blocking forearm. Show clear contact and recoil, followed by an expanding pressure ring that blasts rainwater outward and fractures the asphalt.

At contact, deliver a sharp burst of RGB separation and horizontal signal tearing. Restore a clear image immediately as the movement continues.

Whip-pan into a side-on tracking shot. A drives a heavy punch into B’s guarded ribs.

B slides backward, tearing trenches through the road. The shockwave lifts asphalt slabs and bursts a nearby empty building’s glass facade.
Debris travels outward from the strike. Yellow motion trails and fragmented crimson afterimages emphasize their opposing momentum.

3–5 SECONDS — REALITY FRACTURE
B plants its foot, pivots, and swings its staff in a savage diagonal counterattack.

A crimson energy slash cuts across the viewer’s image plane, opening a glowing fracture through reality directly in front of A.

Shoot from an extreme low Dutch angle as the staff passes close to the lens.

Along the fracture, image strips slide out of alignment. Red-white pixels crawl across the edges. Horizontal static and displaced scanlines expose a narrow black slit.

A ducks beneath the slash.

The camera pushes toward A’s articulated metal hand as it catches the fractured edge and pulls the moving image open like a curtain.

This is a fracture in reality at the camera plane, not a broken billboard or ordinary glass.
5–8 SECONDS — BODY BECOMES MIST
Without pausing, A transforms its entire body into dense black industrial mist threaded with yellow sparks and tiny metal particles.

Feet and legs dissolve first, followed by torso and arms. Its skull and reaching hand disappear last.

Mechanical surfaces progressively fragment into smoky particles and granular digital noise. Show the physical anatomy continuously becoming vapor.

A’s former position becomes completely empty.

The mist flows through the opened fracture.

Rise into an overhead view of Shibuya’s diagonal crossings. Follow one coherent ribbon of black-and-yellow mist racing around B’s blind side and converging directly behind the king.

Use streaming pixel trails and localized datamoshing within the moving vapor. Keep its path and destination obvious.

8–10 SECONDS — REASSEMBLY AND COMBINATION
Dive into a low rear three-quarter angle behind B’s whipping crimson cape.
The mist converges and reconstructs A behind the king. Yellow particles condense into the original skull, armor, arms, and legs.

Digital noise contracts into the mechanical surfaces and disappears as each part becomes solid.

A immediately attacks. B pivots toward the movement.

From over A’s yellow shoulder, show a left body punch connecting with B’s ribs, followed by a compact elbow that snaps the king’s upper body sideways.

Each contact creates a brief pulse of image displacement, metallic sparks, and dirty static. Keep the connecting fist, cracking bone, and recoil visible.

Arc toward a clear three-quarter side angle as A plants its foot and draws back its right fist.

10–13 SECONDS — FINAL PUNCH AND COMPLETE DESTRUCTION
A steps forward and drives one decisive rising right straight into B’s sternum.

Show unmistakable fist-to-bone contact from a powerful low angle.
Use a fraction of a second of slow motion at contact, then accelerate into explosive destruction.

A concentrated glitch pulse erupts from the contact point: RGB channels split outward, the surrounding image briefly shears horizontally, and coarse electronic noise follows the expanding shockwave.

B’s ribcage caves inward and shatters outward.

Cracks race through its spine, skull, crown, antlers, arms, and legs. The entire skeletal king physically breaks into thousands of small fragments and fine powder.

Its staff splinters. Its crimson robes tear into scattered scraps.

Mix the flying physical fragments with brief pixel breakup and corrupted motion trails. Show the destruction clearly; the king must visibly shatter rather than simply disappear.

The same impact creates a massive radial shockwave across Shibuya. Asphalt buckles into a crater. Crossing slabs erupt. Nearby empty building facades collapse, and billboard supports bend and fall.

A remains solid and intact through the follow-through.
13–15 SECONDS — AFTERMATH
Pull back into a ground-level wide shot of the devastated intersection.

A stands alone in the crater, slowly lowering its fist as rain and dust move through the damaged city lights.

Only tiny bone chips, snapped antler fragments, broken crown pieces, and torn crimson cloth remain of B.

The king is completely pulverized. No intact skull, body, crown, or antlers remain. It does not regenerate.

Let the aggressive digital interference decay into faint grain and residual noise on damaged billboards.

Finish with a slow camera drift around A’s yellow-and-black silhouette while debris settles around its feet.

CAMERA
Use ground-level tracking, extreme low angles, a hand close-up, an overhead reveal, an over-the-shoulder attack, and a clear final impact angle.

Connect cuts through movement and preserve spatial continuity.

Use selective motion blur during acceleration, crisp silhouettes at contact, and camera shake precisely on impact.

SOUND
Heavy metallic punches, sharp bone fractures, tearing digital distortion, rushing mist, deep shockwaves, collapsing concrete, and raining glass.

Synchronize short bitcrushed crackles and electronic noise with the glitch bursts.
Build aggressive industrial percussion through the fight. Drop the music at the final punch, exposing the impact and destruction. Finish with rain, settling debris, and fading electrical interference.

FINAL REQUIREMENTS
Full-screen 16:9 moving cinematic video.
No dialogue, subtitles, added titles, or watermarks.
Preserve character identity through every glitch.
Maintain continuous physical motion and readable combat.
Show full-body mist transformation, directional travel, and complete reconstruction.
Major environmental destruction follows visible impacts.
The yellow cyborg survives.
The skeletal king is completely pulverized.
```

### How to adapt it

Supply two distinct character references, preserve their scale difference, and tie each glitch burst to a visible physical impact.
